      Explore the Features of DOOGEE Blade 10 Power

      The Thinnest Rugged Phone with 10300mAh Large Battery

      The DOOGEE Blade 10 Power stands out because it boasts a colossal 10300mAh battery. This means you can use your phone for days without worrying about recharging. Whether you're playing games, streaming videos, or browsing the internet, the battery lasts longer than many other smartphones. So, it’s perfect for users who demand power throughout the day.

      Enjoy Smooth Operation Without Slowdowns

      DOOGEE Blade10 Power offers ample RAM of up to 24GB and 256GB ROM for users to effortlessly switch between social media platforms, video playback, and other apps without experiencing slowdowns.

      6.6” Ultra-clear Notch-less Punch Display

      DOOGEE Blade 10 Power is guaranteed to meet all your professional or entertainment needs. Every media content is displayed with a perfect color richness and vibrancy, making every moment more immersive.
      · 6.6-inch Fullview Display · 720*1612 Ultra-clear Resolution · 16.7 Million Colors Display ·

      Warranty Policy

      All products purchased from the DOOGEE official website include a 1-year limited warranty and lifetime technical support.

      Warranty Covers

      • Manufacturing defects
      • Product quality issues under normal use
      • Repair service
      • Replacement parts
      • Product replacement
      • Technical support

      Warranty Does Not Cover

      • Accidental damage
      • Misuse or unauthorized repair
      • Cosmetic wear and tear
      • Damage caused by drops, abuse or external force
      • Modified or disassembled products
      • Water damage caused by improper use

      Warranty Support

      • Please contact DOOGEE support before returning or repairing any product.
      • For full details, view the Warranty & Return Policy.
      • For extended warranty information, view the Extended Warranty Policy.
      Shipping Policy

      DOOGEE offers free worldwide shipping through its global warehouse network.

      Estimated Delivery Time

      • United States: 3-10 business days
      • European Union: 3-10 business days
      • United Kingdom: 3-10 business days
      • Canada / Mexico: 7-18 business days
      • Other international regions: 7-18 business days

      Order Processing

      • Most orders are processed within 24-48 business hours.
      • Orders placed on weekends or holidays may require additional processing time.
      • Pre-order products follow the estimated shipping schedule shown on the product page.

      Shipping Notes

      • Delivery time is estimated from the shipping date, not the order date.
      • Delivery may be affected by customs clearance, local carrier delays, weather, remote areas, peak seasons or holidays.
      • Once your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with tracking information.
